correctness.rationale: Independently constructed KG(5,2) on the ten 2-subsets of [5] and classified all 1024 vertex sets by induced acyclicity and degree bound. Exact face totals d=0,1,2,3 are 76,261,621,786 (empty included); deterministic vertex-toggle Morse reductions leave only critical cells {0:1,2:4},{0:1,3:1},{0:1,3:1},{0:1,5:6} with 35,129,309,389 pairs respectively, and all 170,860,2540,3470 Hasse incidences topologically sort. Since each reduced CW model has a point and only cells of one positive dimension, these give integral sphere wedges. The RELATIVE F2\F1 has exactly 360 faces, 179 acyclic relative toggle pairs and only two critical cells masks 538 (dimension3), 914 (dimension4); independent exact signed unit-pivot cancellation gives relative boundary -1, establishing zero integral relative homology. As both F1,F2 are simply connected, Whitehead gives actual inclusion homotopy equivalence; persistent groups and nonshellability of pure 5-dimensional F2 with H3=Z follow. No extrapolation to other cubic graphs.

evidence: Carnero Bravo covers paths, cycles, double stars, cactus, graph products, complete multipartite in inspected sections; Petersen is noncactus nonchordal. Published Ind2(P)≃S3 is exactly F1 but lacks F2 relative and terminal F3.
